plain_text:
Due to this movie being NC-17 it's pretty much nonstop graphic violence after the half hour mark, but I've listed the Timestamps anyway if anyone would like to make use of them.
This movie only has a couple spots of inappropriate content so it's a good choice if you want a horror movie where you're not constantly skipping trashy scenes.

15:18 - 16:19 A Booklet has some drawings of skulls and other terrifying things such as loose eyeballs, a face stretched out etc. and a couple human bat like creatures that may or may not have a bit of a "butt" shape you can make out but not graphic at all if it is.

NUDITY/RAPE
25:08 - 27:06 A tree wraps it's branches around Cheryl and ties her down, tears off most of her clothing and violates her. She breaks free then runs away.
Then from 27:06 - 29:29 As she is running away, she's seen in a tattered shirt and underwear. Sometimes as she is running you can see her bare chest and back where the shirt is ripped. She panics and runs to the cabin, where Ashley opens the door.
Go from 25:08 - 29:29 to skip the tree sequence entirely.
VIOLENCE/MAY BE FRIGHTENING/EXTREME GORE
35:34 - 36:05 Cheryl starts increasingly getting louder and scary in tone of voice, then turns around and looks like she has been possessed. Her eyes are white, looks to have bruising and she has a scary expression on her face. She's floating in the air.
36:43 - 37:51 Cheryl (still possessed looking) gets a pencil and stabs Linda in the foot, lots of blood comes out. She then throws Ashley into a cabinet and then gets kicked into a cellar to be locked in. She now is extremely wrinkly with red eyes and gray hair.
39:58 - 40:10 Cheryl is shown as a creepy looking white skinned, wrinkly gray haired, red eyed person that makes unsettling sounds and laughs.
43:20 - 48:47 Long sequence of violence: Scott is grabbed and cut on the side of his face with a fingernail by Shelly, who has been possessed. Lots of blood spills out, he manages to get out of the bathroom and into the living room where he throws Shelly into the fire but frantically pulls her out. Both possessed and scary red eyed and bloody/bruised skinned Woman are shown, they make eerie and extremely unsettling screeches . Shelly has half her hand get cut off by Scott, she then bites off the rest of her own hand and then stabs herself in the back. White liquid shoots out from her wound and mouth. She tries to grab Scott but he axes her to pieces and dismembers her.
48:47 - 49:22 Ashley and Scott take out a white sheet with Shelly's presumed body parts to bury. the bottom of the sheet is very bloody. They dig a hole and place the sheet in the ground.
50:42 - 50:57 Cheryl who is locked in the basement, talks to Ashley as he goes by and says "soon you will all be like me. Then who will lock you up in the cellar?!" then laughs manically with a demon like voice.
51:18 - 51:56 Linda's foot sore starts to grow in a spiderweb shaped pattern, she then springs up from bed and is now possessed. Ashley runs out to the doorway away from her and Scott pops up out of nowhere with a wound in his leg and face and he's bleeding all over.
From 51:56 - 54:46 the possessed Woman and bleeding Scott are all seen making creepy cackling noises. Ashley goes up to one and hits them in the face as they laugh.
56:08 - 57:35 Cheryl grabs up from the cellar and tries to pull Ashley's face, he gets loose. he then drags Linda, who has become repossessed, outside.
57:37 - 1:00:44 Scott is still seen on the couch with many many bleeding wounds.
58:36 - 1:00:44 Linda comes up to Ashley and stabs him in the arm. They get into a fight and she eventually is stabbed through by him. Scott falls on the floor with blood coming out his mouth as well. Ashley drags Linda off and ties her up in a shed to dismember her by chainsaw.
1:01:06 - 1:01:36 Ashley gets out he chainsaw, ready to dismember Linda but he can't do it so he stops and puts it down. Instead walks outside to bury her.
1:02:42 - 1:04:43 Possessed Woman seen again. Cheryl is breaking out of the cellar and Linda's eyes keep opening and then closing when Ashley looks at her. He burries her in the ground.
1:05:00 - 1:06:47 Linda's hand grabs him from under the ground and she pops up. She tears into his leg flesh and blood squirts everywhere. He gets away and grabs a huge piece of wood and hits her over the head with it. She is decapitated after Ashley swings a shovel at her head. Her body keeps attacking him  a bit and blood squirts everywhere onto him.
1:07:56 - 1:08:55 Cheryl escapes the cellar and pops up out of nowhere to fight Ashley. He shoots her in the face and some hanging off flesh is seen. She continues to try and attack him, he shoves her hand in the door on the opposite side and crushes it.
1:09:28 - 1:11:42 A pipe dripping with blood explodes and covers Ashley. Wall outlets, lightbulbs and cracks in the walls start spilling with blood. The whole place is covered in blood. He goes and gets a gun and bullets from the cellar.
1:15:46 - 1:18:57 One of the Possessed Woman grab Ashley through the door. He manages to escape their grasp and shoots them in the face, a huge gash is now missing from their face. Then Scott gets up behind Ashley and tries to hurt him as he is now possessed as well. Ashley gouges out his eyeballs and stabs him in the stomach. Tons and tons of blood pours out. All of his friends who are now possessed try to attack him constantly. He is hit and bitten.
At 1:18:57 - 1:22:28 Ashley throws the book of the dead into the fireplace which stops everyone in their tracks. They all start melting into piles of ground looking meat and goo. Hands come out of their stomachs as well as they abliterate. Piles of remains are seen on the ground.

title: FAQ For Our Page! 💬
plain_text:
CONTACT
FAQ: I'm needing more info on something or need to ask you a question, where do I contact you?
You can either comment on one of our posts and it'll reach us or you can go to our shop and scroll to the bottom of the page and our "Contact" button will be featured there with a little envelope
MOVIE POSTS
FAQ: My movie I'm trying is missing some categories, why?
You may have come upon one of our posts that was for a member that requested a specific category/content type to be removed or an old Reddit list, that's why at the bottom of every post we ask if you have any questions, as everyone has their specific/special things they want removed and we're helping out with that, just let us know in the comments of what you need and we'll get everything for you ;) (this only applies to Memberships that include requests)
FAQ: Why wasn't my content I need removed found?
In order for us to do our job well, you'll need to be specific in what you need skipped, we're not mind readers lol, we try our best but sometimes it's hard to know what people want taken out due to everyone has a different version of what's considered "concerning content" which is why we have the options open to ask us anything about a movie and it's content, so fire away the questions! We don't mind and it'll help us out a lot in helping you out :)
FAQ: I see some movies in the shop but not all, why is this?
We have converted some of our movies into PDF form and they're in the shop, some aren't converted yet (as it takes a process of adding a few things to this version and converting it into a PDF) and we've been busy prioritizing our time into creating more movie timestamps for everyone and our members, if you need a movie turned into a shop item, let us know and we'll get right on that!
FAQ: What types of things do you usually skip?
Here's a list of things we usually find timestamps for people and generally what people are wanting skipped that we've talked with:
NUDITY
SEX SCENES
SEXUAL CONTENT/REMARKS/CONVERSATIONS
INAPPROPRIATE CONTENT
KISSING
SEXUAL GESTURES (such as the middle finger or anything else gesturing sexual acts)
INNUENDOS
CLOTHING
NO SHIRT
UNDERWEAR
BRA
GORE
VIOLENCE
SCARY CONTENT
BLOOD
WEAPONS
DRUG CONTENT/USE
ALCOHOL CONTENT
MAY BE DISTURBING
MAY BE CONCERNING
LANGUAGE/CUSSING
SACRILEGE
GROSS CONTENT (such as puking or soiling one's self)
GENDER AGENDA CONTENT
SEXUAL ORIENTATION CONTENT
SENSORY RELATED CONTENT (such as things that can trigger seizures or noises etc)
Most people we've found things for have requested that nudity and sexual content be found (of their own definition) and so you may need to request on every post what YOUR specific needs are and we'll help you know if your content if present in the movie and we'll help you out! Don't be shy we'll find anything :)
Also again, everyone has their own idea of what fits into these categories so please be specific so we can help you out to our fullest abilities as this page only works based off of the viewers own needs (as it should be cause you guys are the ones using these) but we anyways try our best to gather the most concerning categories and major things first so it's helpful ;)
All these categories listed are not always listed in a movie, again, we gather main categories we think people will need first and assist with other categories as needed :)
FAQ: Why isn't cussing/sacrilege listed?
For us to remove these things we've created a separate membership, as most people we've made timestamps for don't have a need for this and it takes a good amount of time and effort on our part to find these and expect some effort on your part to be skipping every 5 seconds on some shows lol
Plus we were just unsure (and finding 200 some cuss words in a show takes a long time) if people really did want to be that diligent with skipping as some shows would be excessive and not that fun to deal with we could imagine lol
FAQ: How do I find a movie I'm looking for?
At the top of our page there's a button "Posts" click/push that and it'll lead you to our movies available.
If you're looking for a specific movie, there's a little search button present there and you can use that to search any movie (it's a little magnify glass like most use) if your movie isn't in our list you can search "Requesting" and that'll bring up our requesting timestamps posts that you can comment on to receive timestamps from us on that particular movie you're wanting (If you're on a membership that includes requests)
If you're looking for a TV series, those can be found over in our shop in the same way
FAQ: Why are some posts not as descriptive as other posts?
They may have been a request to not divulge info for spoiler purposes or not wanting to read a scene that's being described in a way that the viewer wouldn't like, if you need a post to be more descriptive with more scene info, let us know and we'll get everything you need ;)
TV SERIES
FAQ: Why aren't TV series included with my monthly subscription?
All our TV series are a one time purchase that are in PDF download form due to being basically multiple movies in one and it takes us much longer than the amount of time it takes on a regular movie and $6/$7 a month doesn't cover our time and effort on these, we hope you understand :)
SHOP
FAQ: I can't find the shop, where is it?
We've gotten this question quite a few times and here's something to help everyone out struggling with this:
Same as posts, navigate to the top of our page and push the "Shop" button and you'll be redirected to our shop, there you can either scroll to find your movie or search with the magnify glass button
EXCLUSIVE TO MONTHLY MEMBERSHIPS
FAQ: Why can't I find anything on my membership when I could before?
We've just recently been informed of this type of thing, it seems that when you're subscribed you have a personal profile interface instead of our main website, all you have to do is press our "TheTimestampDudes" name on one of the posts present on your profile and it'll take you to our main page again, no idea why it does this, but hey, hope this helps lol
FAQ: What about movies on disks/DVD?
Movies that are found only on DVD due to they're either older or only available in the US to be shipped from another country on disk, will have to be decided on whether or not the member would be willing to pay for the expenses of having to ship the DVD to us, the movie cost and our extra effort to buy and ship this movie for you. Especially with disks, it's also a risk that the DVD may not come usable, so that's something to think about. We'll inform you if a specific movie requested is only available in this way, but most are available on some form of streaming but some niche movies and foreign films end up having this issue.
FAQ: What if I need more movie requests per week on my subscription?
You can grab another $7 subscription with an alternate email and list it as ("your original name" 2) or use our open to everyone requests at $5, this is to insure it's not seen by other members as us giving out extra free requests to a specific account and each request goes with it's own paid for membership.
(This is also listed on the monthly membership requesting post)
FOR USERS NOT ON OUR MONTHLY MEMBERSHIP
FAQ: How do I request movies?
We have a public version of requesting open to everyone in our posts, search "Requesting" to find that post with more info
FAQ: What's included in the $7 a month membership? How do I know what I'm going to get?
Included in our $7 monthly membership:
All posts we have available on movies (that are going to be continuously updated to further our library and broaden our selections, *does not include shop items*)
Access to requesting timestamps for free (1 per week)
You'll be supporting our efforts to gather every movie for everyone so anybody can get what they need
We'll be able to do more for you when our time and efforts are being compensated and we greatly appreciate it!
A more direct line to talking with us and getting the content info and timestamps you specifically need
Being part of a community that all think alike in terms of wanting to clean up movies
Access to literally any movie you want and any content you want skipped or informed on (within page safety guidelines featured at the bottom of this post)
FAQ: What about movies on disks/DVD?
Movies that are found only on DVD due to they're either older or only available in the US to be shipped from another country on disk, will have to be decided on whether or not the member would be willing to pay for the expenses of having to ship the DVD to us, the movie cost and our extra effort to buy and ship this movie for you. Especially with disks, it's also a risk that the DVD may not come usable, so that's something to think about. We'll inform you if a specific movie requested is only available in this way, but most are available on some form of streaming but some niche movies and foreign films end up having this issue.
SUPPORT FEATURE (the "Buy me a Popcorn feature")
FAQ: What does supporting you do?
It helps us continue to provide the service we do and encourages us to keep going even when it can be exhausting at times, we also try to use our support money to fund our streaming services that help everyone get all the movies they need (including standalone movies not found on platforms), also if you just enjoy our service and some of our free movie posts and want to show us your thanks :)
FOR ALL USERS/VIEWERS
FAQ: Why is my Movie taking so long?
Normally the reason is due to we watch your specific movie and go over everything manually, list things, make sure each scene doesn't have something hidden in it, formulate the timestamps in a way that will be useful such as: transcribing dialogue in skipped scenes, writing out the timestamps directions in a way that will be clear and helpful, checking with each other to make sure two sets of eyes are on something so there's a second opinion on possible concerning content and some movies are upwards of 3 hours long so the wait may be a tad longer ;) but we try to be as quick as possible but without missing anything you may be concerned about so it's a catch 22
Also..we get a ton of power outages where we live, so if we don't respond or something seems like it's taking a really really long time, consider we may just be in a blackout lol
FAQ: Do you use some type of software to find these timestamps or do you go over them manually?
This is our most asked question by practically everyone so:
No we don't use any type of software, we personally don't trust computers to find something a real human would be concerned about and things real humans would be able to understand concerning this type of thing, we go over every movie manually to ensure nothing is missed that you're concerned about, this is also why there's a bit of a wait to get your timestamps and you need to be specific on what you want, we just want to be thorough ;)
FAQ: How does your site work/operate?
We do things in this fashion:
Viewer requests timestamps + We respond and get on finding them for you + we post them and inform you that they're done + you can then go find them in Posts or in the shop depending on what you wanted
